![the drawer: the clearest control in the realm](shots/drawer-3440.png)

**The four breaks are fixed, re-proven cold.** Every tab centre now hit-tests to the tab, not the bar; a real click on **Pricing** lands at 1280 and 3440 and the box rect is *identical* before and after (2739×371 at 3440) under a caption that finally agrees; no literal asterisks on 66 loads; [the takeover](/imagine/paging/library/takeover/) keeps the rail at both widths and shows **leave full screen**.
